measure.sourceTitle: The Best 4 Star Hotels in Sydney from $92 | Expedia
measure.evidenceText: Expedia's 4-star Sydney trend table shows August $158. It states price-trend information excludes taxes and fees and is based on base rates for a nightly stay for 2 adults found in the last 7 days and averaged for commonly viewed 4-star properties in Sydney.
measure.referencePeriod: Expedia result crawled last week; trend based on base rates found in the last 7 days; August monthly value.
measure.searchQuery: site:expedia.com Sydney Australia 4-star hotels average nightly price trend 2 adults taxes fees
measure.reason: Accepted as source-feasibility evidence with a known excluded-tax base-rate basis; it is not an inclusive product observation.
